scope: Local deterministic evidence-contract, tenant-isolation, API/BFF minimization, operator rendering, accessibility, and fresh isolated PostgreSQL verification. Synthetic organizations, memberships, canonical records, provenance, financial values, exceptions, and reconciliation evidence only. No customer data, provider system, protected staging, compliance, reliability, accuracy, or production-readiness claim is included.

requirement.priorGap: The API and BFF allowed named deterministic evidence, record references, and normalized records through generic JSON contracts, and the operator views lacked one strict semantic projection.
requirement.implementedMeaning: strict bounded stored evidence plus a tenant-verified versioned browser view with semantic rendering and fail-closed unavailable fallback

relationalChecks: source and normalized comparison arrays have equal cardinality
record IDs and record-version IDs match in order
untruncated evidence count equals the exact record-version count
candidate evaluated and emitted counts do not exceed eligible/evaluated counts
complete candidate search evaluates every eligible candidate
incomplete candidate search emits no partial shortlist
each accounting overflow lower bound exceeds its selected 500-entry or 50-entry mode

investigation: rule, rule-set, result, confidence, reason, tolerance, time, and record-count summary
semantic side-by-side source and normalized comparison table

covered: typed exception comparisons and field lineage

newAssertions: valid deterministic evidence is projected into paired safe comparisons
canonical normalized records omit API-only tenant and source-event fields
field lineage validates without exposing sourceValueReference
foreign tenant cannot resolve the primary exception
a primary-tenant exception storing a foreign canonical UUID emits no reference or source record

findingAndCorrection.finding: The first strict accountingCandidateSearch schema recognized only the 500-entry amount-window overflow, while the existing engine also emits a distinct 50-entry strong-reference split overflow.
findingAndCorrection.correction: The evaluationLimit is now a strict discriminator: a 500 limit requires a lower bound of at least 501, while a 50 limit requires at least 51.
findingAndCorrection.newRegressionTest: accepts both valid accounting overflow modes and rejects a lower bound paired with the wrong limit
findingAndCorrection.preliminaryFinalGateCorrection: The first final-gate attempt stopped at lint on an unnecessarily explicit boolean-literal comparison in the candidate-overflow UI guard. The expression was changed to direct boolean evaluation without changing behavior, then the complete gate was restarted.

limitations: This is local synthetic control evidence, not a provider acceptance, accuracy, capacity, SLO, compliance, or production-readiness result.
Representative populated historical evidence has not been audited or migrated; unsupported rows intentionally display unavailable.
Protected-runtime response timing, fault injection, multi-replica behavior, and representative query/load behavior remain unverified.
No authorized Shopify or Stripe sandbox credential, request, webhook, or source payload was used.
No owner-approved protected staging target, deployment credential, alert destination, SLO, retention policy, or legal disposition was available.
SEC-L-003 remains open; this increment did not silently migrate or replace authentication/session authority.
No file was staged, committed, pushed, published, or deployed, and no runtime .env file was created.
